$schema_note: Canonical source for Wristotle's user-facing features. Drives the app's Settings → ❓ Help page (via codegen) AND, eventually, the docs site's features table. Hand-edited; companion repo carries a synced copy at data/features.json. Newest first. Each release that ships a user-facing feature gets one entry; internals-only patches are intentionally omitted (no Help page row, no docs feature-table row). Style guide for each field lives in app/.../help/HelpContent.kt's file-level KDoc.

features.title: Export your tasks to a folder
features.description: Tasks now sync to a folder as a live Markdown checklist (Settings → Tasks), the same way notes do — Obsidian, Dropbox, git, any plain-text app.

features.title: Choose which calendar events go to
features.description: Pick the calendar/account that voice-created events are added to (Settings → Calendar), instead of always the primary one.

features.title: Run timers on the watch
features.description: "Set a timer" can now count down on your Pebble and buzz when it’s up — even if the app is closed — instead of opening the phone’s clock (Settings → Watch).

features.title: Ask Agent remembers the conversation
features.description: Ask Agent now keeps recent turns so follow-ups work ("and tomorrow?"), with a configurable limit, spoken reset words, and an idle timeout.

features.title: Route everything to Ask Agent
features.description: New routing modes send unrecognised speech — or every spoken command, with no wake word — straight to your Ask Agent provider.

features.title: "And a half" timers and alarms
features.description: Durations like "an hour and a half" or "two and a half hours from now" are now understood for timers and alarms, instead of being misread.
features.sample_query: set a timer for an hour and a half

features.title: Failed actions stay on the watch
features.description: A failed or unrecognized voice command now stays on the watch screen, with the time you asked, until you press Back — instead of vanishing like a success.

features.title: Ask Agent connects to more MCP servers
features.description: Ask Agent can now reach MCP servers that use the older SSE transport, such as a self-hosted n8n; the connection no longer fails on a duplicated address.

features.title: Wake-word and watch-code fixes
features.description: Add several custom wake words, set how long a voice-recalled code stays on the watch, and open your codes from a watch button.

features.title: Control Home Assistant by voice
features.description: Say "hey home assistant …" and Wristotle sends the command to your self-hosted Home Assistant and speaks back its reply.
features.sample_query: hey home assistant turn off the kitchen lights

features.title: Cloud voice replies are no longer silent
features.description: Speak-on-watch with a cloud or self-hosted TTS provider could produce no sound with some servers; the streamed audio now decodes and plays.

features.title: Save loyalty cards and QR codes on your watch
features.description: Scan or enter loyalty cards and QR codes; they show full-screen on the watch, even offline, and you can recall one by voice.

features.title: Ask Agent works with slow local models
features.description: Settings → ✨ Ask Agent has a Response timeout you can raise, so slow on-device models that "think" before answering aren't cut off mid-reply.

features.title: Find my phone rings loud, even on silent
features.description: "Find my phone" now rings at full alarm volume and vibrates from the phone, so you hear it even with the media volume muted.

features.title: Choose what's in your Morning Brief
features.description: Pick which sections your morning brief includes — meetings, alarms, messages, reminders, tasks, or notes.

features.title: Replies show as cards on the watch
features.description: Sports, weather and meeting replies now appear as full-screen cards on the watch — switch on more in Settings.

features.title: Cricket adds the Big Bash League
features.description: Cricket now covers Australia's Big Bash League — ask for BBL standings or whether your team won.

features.title: Sports data updates itself — or on demand
features.description: Sports leagues and teams now refresh automatically, and Settings → Sports has an Update sports data button to pull the latest now.

features.title: Speak sports replies on your watch
features.description: Sports answers can now be read aloud on your watch — there's a new Sports toggle under Settings → Speech.

features.title: Formula 1 qualifying, sprint and pole results
features.description: Ask Formula 1 for qualifying, sprint, or pole results, and every race answer now shows which session it's from.
features.sample_query: who won the last f1 qualifying

features.title: Formula 1 and cricket, plus per-sport on/off
features.description: Sports adds Formula 1 (races + driver/constructor standings) and cricket (IPL, World Cup), and lets you switch off sports you don't follow in Settings → Sports.
features.sample_query: when is the next f1 race

features.title: Sports scores, schedules, and standings
features.description: Ask any team's next game, last result, live score, or league standings — across soccer, the NBA, NFL, MLB, and NHL.
features.sample_query: when do the warriors play next

features.title: On-device activity stats page
features.description: Settings → 📊 Stats surfaces top intents, active hours, accuracy, and where Wristotle stumbles — all computed on-device.

features.title: SetAlarm accepts compound durations + dotted AM/PM
features.description: "Set an alarm for one hour and four minutes from now" now sets an alarm 64 minutes ahead instead of erroring (closes #12). "Set an alarm for 7:51 p.m." parses the same as "7:51 pm" — the dots in a.m./p.m. no longer break the time parser. SetTimer + SetAlarm now share one duration-parsing helper so they can't drift apart again.
features.sample_query: set an alarm for one hour and four minutes from now

features.title: TTS settings now travel in backups + diagnostics
features.description: Settings → 🔊 Speech is now included in Backup & Restore — mode, endpoint, voice, model, and per-intent toggles all survive a phone reset. The API key rides only when you tick the secret checkbox (off by default), same as every other key. The Diagnostics bug-report export also captures the TTS provider state (set/empty only — never the key value).

features.title: Speak replies on the watch (experimental)
features.description: Settings → 🔊 Speech turns voice replies on. Pick which intents speak (Ask Agent / Morning brief / Reminders / Tasks / Notes / Calendar / Lookups / …), pick a TTS engine (Android local, or any OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech endpoint), and test it in the same card. Cloud TTS hits ~1 s time-to-first-audio. Pebble Time 2 + Pebble Round 2 only — every other watch model drops the chunks silently. Off by default.
features.sample_query: ask agent what is the capital of france

features.title: Voice fixes — punctuation, word numbers, cancel timer
features.description: Sent text messages preserve the trailing ? / ! you said. SetTimer / SetAlarm / Reminder all recognise 11-19 and 21-99 as word-form durations ("set a timer for eleven minutes"). "Cancel timer" now points to the Clock app instead of claiming there's no reminder by that name (#11).
features.sample_query: set a timer for eleven minutes

features.title: Morning brief catches dismissed notifications (opt-in)
features.description: Optional persisted log lets the brief include notifications you swiped or cleared earlier today. App id + conversation key + timestamp only — never the body or sender.

features.title: Persistent reminders — keep nagging until you tap Stop
features.description: Ask for a "persistent reminder" or "nag me" and your phone re-fires the reminder every few minutes after the watch pin fires (#10).
features.sample_query: persistent reminder to take meds at nine

features.title: Self-hosted endpoints over HTTP work again
features.description: Ask Agent, STT, and MCP requests to plain http:// URLs (LAN, Tailscale, self-signed) no longer get blocked by Android (#9).

features.title: Morning brief — voice rollup of today's plate
features.description: One-shot rollup of today's meetings, alarms, reminders, tasks, notes, and unread messages from your messaging apps.

features.title: Bug fixes — relative alarms + Permissions tab polish
features.description: Relative alarms ("an hour from now") fire on time again; Voice Input no longer leaves an empty card (#7, #8).
features.sample_query: set an alarm for an hour from now

features.title: Watch polish + opt-in color theme + chat bubbles
features.description: Per-row icons across every list, rounded chat bubbles, and an opt-in colour theme controlled from the companion (color-capable watches only).

features.title: Folder sync for Notes + Conversations
features.description: Sync Notes and Conversations to any folder on your phone — Obsidian, Joplin, Dropbox, git vault — Markdown by default.

features.title: Claude web search + smarter aliases + reminder polish
features.description: Anthropic web-search toggle for Ask Agent, smarter app-alias matching, and cleaner reminder titles (#4).
features.sample_query: ask claude what's the score of today's lakers game

features.title: MCP server card — edit, enable/disable, scheme guard
features.description: MCP servers gain in-place edit, an enable/disable toggle, a raw-token scheme-guard warning, and a 401-refresh crash fix.

features.title: Leaving alpha — first-launch setup wizard
features.description: Leaving alpha. First-launch wizard walks new users through models, permissions, and app scan; persistent Settings → 🌟 Setup card.

features.title: Cloud + self-hosted speech-to-text
features.description: Pick on-device Whisper, any OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint, or a primary + fallback pair. "Test connection" verifies before first use.

features.title: Import custom Whisper models
features.description: Sideload any whisper.cpp .bin from your phone (fine-tuned, language-specific, distilled). Magic bytes validated before copy.

features.title: Alarms with phone / watch / both destinations
features.description: Re-do of the alarm feature. Settings → ⏰ Alarms & Reminders → Alarms — create one-shot alarms via the editor (time + label + destination: Phone / Watch / Both) or by voice ("set an alarm for 7am" honours the default-destination dropdown). "Cancel the alarm" / "cancel 7am alarm" cancels watch alarms; phone alarms still have to be dismissed in the system clock. New BUTTON_ACTION_ALARMS = 4 lets you bind SELECT / long-press UP / long-press DOWN to the on-watch alarm list.

features.title: Configurable chat-surface shortcuts
features.description: Bind SELECT, long-press UP, and long-press DOWN on the watch chat screen to any of Dictation, Quick menu (chooser), Notes, or Tasks. Defaults keep the existing muscle memory. Edit via Wristotle's gear-icon settings or the companion's Watch settings card.

features.title: In-app Help page
features.description: Settings → ❓ Help. Searchable feature history (newest first), discovery tips, deep-links into the docs. Shows watch versions alongside companion versions for paired releases.

features.title: Custom Ask Agent trigger words
features.description: Add your own wake words for Ask Agent — works as a verb ("ask jarvis …") or bare ("Jarvis, …").

features.title: Faster Whisper models + RAM hint
features.description: New q4_0 quantised Tiny / Base / Small variants. Each model row now shows the approximate RAM cost.

features.title: Per-category backup selection
features.description: Pick exactly what your backup includes. Sensitive items (API keys, headers) default to OFF.

features.title: Ask Agent (LLM + MCP tools)
features.description: Route voice queries to any LLM you configure. Optional MCP tool calling lets the LLM take live actions.
features.sample_query: ask agent what's the capital of France

features.title: Weather
features.description: Voice weather for any city or your current location. open-meteo by default, OpenWeather optional.

features.title: World clock & calculator
features.description: Time in any city, plus on-device arithmetic with spoken operators. Both fully offline.
features.sample_query: what time is it in Tokyo

features.title: Alarms & timers
features.description: Set alarms and countdown timers by voice. The system Clock app handles the ring.

features.title: See and prune learned phrases
features.description: View — and individually delete — phrases Wristotle has learned from your voice commands.

features.title: Contact aliases
features.description: Map a spoken phrase to the right contact — fixes the "Whisper mishears my friend's name" problem.

features.title: Tasks
features.description: Voice-controlled checklist with on-watch picker and a companion Tasks tab. Included in backups.

features.title: WhatsApp / Telegram / Signal messaging
features.description: Voice messaging across SMS plus three third-party apps via one intent. (Third-party apps need a tap to send.)

features.title: Reliable "open <app>" from the watch
features.description: Cold-start launch of any installed app from the watch (needs Display over other apps).

features.title: Settings drill-down navigation
features.description: Settings reorganised into focused sub-screens you reach with one tap from a landing list.

features.title: Confirm before dispatch
features.description: Optional watch prompt before destructive actions (call, text, alarm). Configurable timeout + default.

features.title: Backup & Restore
features.description: Export your data to a single ZIP and import it on a fresh install. AES-256 encryption optional.

features.title: Voice notes, Quick Launch, App aliases
features.description: Take voice notes, jump to dictation with a single watch press, and alias app names you call things differently.

features.title: Reminder list & reschedule
features.description: Ask what's pending; push a reminder to a new time. The watch hint routes cleanly into list / set / reschedule.

features.title: Voice calendar
features.description: Schedule events and ask what's coming up. Reads your default calendar.
features.sample_query: schedule a meeting with Alex at 3pm

features.title: Watch settings from the phone
features.description: Configure watch-side toggles (font sizes, hints, defaults) from the companion app.

features.title: Initial release
features.description: Calls, SMS, time-based reminders, media play / pause / next / previous / seek, find phone. All on-device.
